EUV Lithography and Programmable Nanostructures at the Limit English Introduction and Research Abstract This monograph develops a falsifiable research program for using extreme-ultraviolet lithography to manufacture nanostructures with verified optical, electrical, mechanical, or quantum-sensitive functions. Its premise is deliberately stricter than "smaller features are better." A structure qualifies only when mask intent, exposure, resist chemistry, transferred geometry, and terminal function can be linked through traceable evidence on blind wafer locations. Scientific position The core candidate expression is Y_prog = P(G in Ω_G, F in Ω_F) − λ_D D_stoch − λ_C C_EUV. It treats success as probability mass inside a joint geometry–function acceptance region, discounted by stochastic-defect burden and EUV route cost. All variables, units, normalizations, uncertainty models, and domains must be preregistered. Safety, rights, irreversible harm, missing primary evidence, and terminal functional degradation are hard vetoes that cannot be compensated by a weighted score. Architecture and contents The book contains a scientific-boundary statement, a five-layer architecture, a reading guide, thirty distinct formula derivations, eighty-two chapters with five research sections each, two hundred Research Gates, thirty-three Phoenix Answer Embryos, and two hundred thirty-three Easter-Egg Equations. Every chapter moves from claim and mechanism to experiment, adversarial validation, transfer, and successor use. The single-section-per-page format keeps each decision object visually intact. Layer 01 · Functional grammar: Define geometric primitives, functions, and unacceptable defects before optimization. Layer 02 · Joint stochastic physics: Model source, mask, resist, development, and transfer with visible uncertainty. Layer 03 · Cross-field experiment: Randomize focus and dose across wafer positions and preserve evidence ancestry. Layer 04 · Functional closure: Close the loop on terminal function and distribution tails rather than CD alone. Layer 05 · Portability and succession: Require reconstruction on a second platform and preserve the authority to reject or retire the route. What makes the study testable The minimum prototype prints three parameterized structure families with explicit functional readouts on the same wafer, randomizes focus and dose, and holds out fields from model fitting. A mature design-rule-plus-OPC flow and an electron-beam small-batch route serve as strong comparators. The claim fails when gains disappear outside selected fields, when rare fatal defects are dominated by unmodeled stochasticity, when pattern transfer destroys the functional benefit, or when the cost ceiling is exceeded. Evidence and DOI strategy DOI-bearing sources anchor EUV image formation, stochastic resist physics, secondary-electron chemistry, mask three-dimensional effects, curvilinear inverse lithography, actinic inspection, and nanoscale metrology. Citations support known mechanisms and constraints; they do not convert proposed results into completed experiments. The companion workbook maps DOI records, chapter interfaces, equations, and all Research Gates. Central deliverable The final Phoenix Answer Embryo is the Programmable EUV Structure Atlas: a reconstructable evidence object binding layout grammar, process windows, stochastic defects, terminal functions, negative cases, and successor decisions. Its deepest criterion is not permanence. It is whether a later team can reproduce, refute, fork, or responsibly retire the work without needing the original authors.
